source_text:
14.3 Καὶ ὀνειδισμὸν οὐκ ε λαβεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ε γγιστα αὐτοῦ.
̔Ο ἀνεπιλήπτως βιῶν, ὀνειδισμὸν οὐ λαμ βάνει ἐπὶ τοὺς ε γγιστας αὐτοῦ.
pass_a_gloss: And reproach not he-took upon the nearest of-him. The blamelessly living, reproach not takes upon the nearest of-him.
pass_b_english: “And he did not take reproach against those nearest him” (Psalm 14:3).
The one living blamelessly does not take reproach against those nearest him.

choices.term: ὀνειδισμὸν οὐκ ἔλαβεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἔγγιστα
choices.english: he did not take reproach against those nearest him
choices.why: The blameless life does not take up reproach against neighbors. Not ‘he never heard a reproach’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
